name: Pipe Clamp Bed
subtitle: A level work support that snaps onto 3/4-inch pipe clamps
description: A continuous parametric bed with two easy-release end clips. The default 7 × 1.5 inch support follows a standard 1.050 inch pipe crown, lifts the work only 1/16 inch above it, and reports where the center of a 1 inch board lands relative to the pipe axis.

dimensionTargets: The default bed is 177.8 × 38.1 mm (7 × 1.5 in) with a continuous level support face and two 25.4 mm (1 in) end clips.
The pipe interface targets standard 3/4-14 NPT black pipe at 26.67 mm (1.050 in) maximum outside diameter with 0.8 mm total diametral clearance.
The default support face is 1.6 mm (about 1/16 in) above the nominal pipe crown: 0.4 mm radial fit clearance plus a 1.2 mm supported crown cap.
A 25.4 mm (1 in) workpiece resting on the default surface has its center 27.635 mm (1.088 in) above the pipe axis.
Each default clip has a 3.0 mm wall and 1.2 mm fitted-radius undercut; the nominal pipe requires only 0.8 mm outward movement per side during snap-on or removal.
invariants: Run the 177.8 mm bed length parallel to the pipe and keep the 38.1 mm support width transverse to it.
Use exactly two downward-opening snap clips, one at each end, while keeping the middle underside open around the pipe.
Derive support height from the fitted pipe crown plus crown-cap thickness; do not place a solid flat plate through the pipe envelope.
Keep pipe diameter, total diametral clearance, crown-cap thickness, clip wall, clip width, and retention undercut independently editable.
Keep the translucent pipe as a preview-only fit datum and exclude it from every STL export.
Export the support face flat at Z = 0 with both clips rising upward for the recommended support-free print orientation.
Retain the supplied pipe-supporter STL byte-for-byte as concept evidence, but do not copy its recorded degenerate triangles or non-manifold edges into the procedural model.
Treat the default as a Tough PLA starting point, not a certified clamp component. Print the fit coupon, test the actual pipe, and inspect for whitening or cracks before making the full bed.

scripts.name: audit
scripts.description: Checks reference custody, pipe and workpiece datums, dependent parameter limits, easy-release clip geometry, printable orientation, STL topology, and fit-coupon parity.
